# Building Automation Service Plans — Suspension Period, Reinstatement Fee and Restart Window Figures Written to the Owner

The Building Automation Service Plans carry three figures per tier that are written into the owner's plan terms: the number of calendar days past due after which remote access and monitoring are suspended, the fee charged when a suspended or lapsed plan is restarted, and the number of calendar days after the plan year end within which a lapsed plan restarts without a fresh survey.

| Tier | Suspension after (calendar days past due) | Reinstatement fee (USD) | Restart window (calendar days after plan year end) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Controls Help Desk Subscription | 45 | 125 | 30 |
| Alarm Monitoring Plan | 45 | 225 | 45 |
| Scheduled Controls Service Plan | 45 | 350 | 45 |
| Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan | 30 | 500 | 60 |
| Remote Optimization Plan | 30 | 750 | 60 |
| Integrated Building Automation Partnership | 30 | 1500 | 90 |

As written to the owner:

- The suspension figure is 45 days past due at the three lower tiers and 30 days past due from the Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan upward.
- The reinstatement fee rises with the tier, from 125 USD to 1500 USD.
- The restart window widens with the tier, from 30 days under the Controls Help Desk Subscription to 90 days under the Integrated Building Automation Partnership.
